'''Tropam Givar''' was a [[Rellarin]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi auxiliary]], and one of the most commonly requested agents by the Order at the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="Gamer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tropam Givar is mentioned in an article in [[Star Wars Gamer 8|''Star Wars Gamer'' 8]].
